title: Native API defect baseline
summary: As of 2026-10-23 trunk r13284 fixed global-reference (#2100), UNINIT (#2102), stack discovery (#2106), SysStemSort (#2120), but a native method invalid-arguments stale activation remained. Unpatched forced-GC repro crashed 3/3; local patch survived 3/3 and reported CheckCondition=1. Potential relevance to BSF is mechanistic, not confirmed crash attribution.
invariants: Do not claim upstream merge without verifying newer commits.
Never let a failed native signature leave an activation frame to be scanned by GC.
CheckCondition must be immediately observable and SYNTAX 88.922 propagated correctly.
Separate four upstream repairs from the outstanding native argument defect.
